entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I, uh, I have a problem with an order. I bought a new jersey and... it just doesn't fit. I was so excited for it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it a matter of preference with the fit?

Oh no, it's not torn or anything. It's just... the wrong size. It's really too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and this is the first time I've been this disappointed. I was really hoping to use it for a big ride this month.
I completely understand the frustration when something you're looking forward to doesn't work out. Let me just pull up our policy. Can I get your order number, please?
Sure, it's VF-8675309. I just feel so silly. And honestly, with the holidays coming up, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.

Thank you. I see the order right here. Okay, good news. I see your jersey was delivered 18 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can send it back?
Yes, you certainly can. We have two options. We can process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the next size up. There would be no extra charge for that.
An exchange would be perfect! I really do love the jersey, it was just the wrong size. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really turned my day around.

You're very welcome. I'm happy we could find a solution. I have just initiated the exchange for you, and a pre-paid return label is on its way to your email right now. Just pack up the original item and drop it at any post office.
That's fantastic. I'll get that sent out today. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Nope, that was everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
